label: Plotinus, Enneads V.4.1, opening: There must be a self-standing first principle, prior to all…
locator: V.4.1, opening: δεῖ μὲν γάρ τι πρὸ πάντων ... οὐκ ἂν ἀρχὴ εἴη
interpretation: Source reading recorded in prose only. Records the text’s requirement that there be such a first and its proposed characteristics, not a verified existential proof. The need for a first remains an open philosophical commitment; prior to all is not reduced to graph-source status.
